response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), major_shares AS (SELECT member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM major_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(member_count), 0) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
